abo_noetig.title: Lotus subscription for Home Assistant
abo_noetig.description: Home Assistant is part of the Lotus subscription. While no subscription is active, Home Assistant shows your spa as unavailable and your automations do not switch anything. With a valid subscription everything continues right away.

kein_recht.title: Home Assistant not enabled
kein_recht.description: Home Assistant is not enabled for this Lotus account. Until then, Home Assistant shows your spa as unavailable.
